{
  "name": "cache-meter",
  "displayName": "Cache Meter",
  "version": "0.5.4",
  "description": "Claude Code mod: /keepwarm keeps your prompt cache alive through a break; a countdown, hit rate, context fill and API value above the prompt; and a /tokens dashboard with what caching saved, what fills your context, API errors and cost per hour.",
  "author": {
    "name": "Florian Grimmer",
    "url": "https://github.com/florian101010"
  },
  "homepage": "https://github.com/florian101010/cache-meter#readme",
  "repository": "https://github.com/florian101010/cache-meter",
  "license": "MIT",
  "keywords": [
    "claude-code",
    "claude-code-mod",
    "prompt-caching",
    "prompt-cache",
    "keepwarm",
    "cache-warming",
    "tokens",
    "token-usage",
    "context-window",
    "auto-compact",
    "cost"
  ],
  "documentationUrl": "https://github.com/florian101010/cache-meter#readme",
  "supportUrl": "https://github.com/florian101010/cache-meter/issues",
  "privacyPolicyUrl": "https://github.com/florian101010/cache-meter/blob/main/PRIVACY.md",
  "types": "./types/index.d.ts",
  "userConfig": {
    "cacheTtl": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Cache TTL",
      "description": "auto: derived from Claude Code's TTL controls (FORCE_PROMPT_CACHING_5M, CLAUDE_CODE_PROMPT_CACHE_TTL, promptCacheTtl, ENABLE_PROMPT_CACHING_1H), else 5m once a plan limit is used up, else the value reported on a model switch, else 60m. 60m/5m: fixed, wins over everything.",
      "options": [
        "auto",
        "60m",
        "5m"
      ],
      "default": "auto"
    },
    "autoSidebar": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Sidebar at start",
      "description": "auto: in Claude Code's fullscreen renderer (/tui fullscreen), open the /tokens dashboard as a sidebar beside the chat at session start – placed from 144 terminal columns, 110 once you opened it yourself – and leave it closed once you close it. Never opens above the prompt by itself. off: only with /tokens.",
      "options": [
        "auto",
        "off"
      ],
      "default": "auto"
    }
  }
}
